name: Orc
description: Fierce, green-skinned warriors who respect strength above all else.

name: Goblin
description: Small, cunning scavengers who thrive in the darkest caverns.

name: Fiendblood
description: Mortals bearing the ancestral curse of demonic entities, identifiable by their horns and unusual skin tones.

name: Drakin
description: Proud humanoids boasting dragon-like scales and elemental affinities.

name: Tinkerer (Gnome)
description: Energetic, diminutive inventors driven by obsessive curiosity.

name: Asterion
description: Massive labyrinth-dwellers with the heads of bulls and unparalleled tempers.

name: Giant-kin
description: Towering nomads from the frozen peaks with bloodlines tracing back to ancient titans.

name: Celestial
description: Beings touched by divine light, acting as guardians of the mortal realms.

name: Ironclad
description: Forged for war and granted sentience, these metal juggernauts seek a purpose beyond combat.

name: Nightstalker
description: Cursed undead who sustain themselves on the vitality of the living.

name: Lycan
description: Shapechangers afflicted by a primal curse, constantly balancing their humanity with the beast within.

name: Siren
description: Alluring aquatic humanoids known for their mesmerizing voices and deep-sea telepathy.

name: Centaur
description: Noble half-equine wanderers who possess profound ancestral wisdom.

name: Pixie
description: Tiny, mischievous fey who flutter through the world playing tricks on larger folk.

name: Morpher
description: Faceless shapeshifters who integrate perfectly into any society they choose.

name: Oozeling
description: Sentient gelatinous masses capable of adopting humanoid shapes to interact with others.

name: Shardmind
description: Psychic entities composed entirely of animated, resonating crystal shards.

name: Floran
description: Savage, carnivorous plant-people who thrive in deep wilderness and rely on the sun.

name: Lepidopteran
description: Mysterious, moth-like humanoids drawn to arcane energy and bright lights.

name: Hive-Swarm
description: A collective of thousands of insects acting as a single, terrifyingly intelligent bipedal entity.

name: Umbral
description: Creatures born from the Shadowfell, capable of slipping between reality and the dark.

name: Clockwork Puppet
description: Wooden, gear-driven dolls brought to life by forgotten magic.

name: Chitinous
description: Four-armed desert insects who communicate through clicks, pheromones, and a shared connection.

name: Phantom
description: Spirits bound to the mortal plane, barely interacting with the physical world.

name: Parasited
description: Hosts to alien or demonic symbiotes that grant them incredible, albeit draining, biological surges.
